axes.A: Complete54-line leaf and104-line main read with77-line stamp owner and394-line canonical project-map validator. Real project loader,editor command/creation/draft callers inspected at pinned ranges. Surface rows=height*2,cols=width; legal empty anchor and one col-overflow preserve valid other fields and nullable collision.
axes.B: Remove contributor/gap header which implied a unique uncovered axis despite pending data-guards overlap. Existing null-vs-zero and heights constraints match canonical source. No generated-source or visual-E2E coverage claim.
axes.C: Move one anchor/ownership case into stamp main. Its single-layer fixture is local to its only test; layeredStamps remains shared for multi-source,height,roundtrip and invalid-data cases. No production IO,command state or rendering mixed into content guard tests.
axes.D: Single-layer and two-layer/multi-source fixtures retain distinct semantic payloads; no mode flag or universal builder. Row overflow differs from col overflow. Positive empty-anchor is also the source-preservation observation here; pending data-guards has overlapping refusal checks but lacks these ownership assertions. Do not claim global deduplication or delete unreviewed mixed suite.
axes.E: All4 native identities and every assertion survive. Literal anchor1,1 and unchanged snapshots; col2 rejection with exact message and final tile1 sentinel retained. Main literal collision/category/heights,roundtrip and lockstep checks intact. Expected values are independent source literals, not a reimplementation of guard logic.
axes.F: Stamp tests share actual owner; rename generic fixture to layeredStamps and legalStamp to singleLayerStamp. Private single-layer builder is adjacent to its sole consumer, eliminating arbitrary provenance split.
axes.G: Two files become one; duplicate imports/describe removed, no case/assertion count growth. Use existing snapshot provider only after proving exact old stamp fixture is JSON-literal domain. No new helper export or weaker type/ignore.
axes.H: Pure validators and serialization, fresh fixtures,no mocks/time/IO. Full typed proof includes moved helper return type and every cell; tail tile/type/asset negatives reject changes.41content+16editor adjacent cases are impact evidence, not new acceptance of their files.

axes.A: Complete62-line leaf and49-line main read with62-line owner. Real project-loader validates against asset catalog; scene-stage resolves stable ID before loading binary asset. Both positive/negative catalogs pass actual validateAssetCatalog; missing ID and kind mismatch are explicit supported rejection inputs.
axes.B: Remove obsolete wave/gap header and W7B-only group suffix. Missing-catalog and wrong-kind titles reflect exact rejection strings; preserve path prohibition and retired-field explanations. No claim a sprite neighbor is itself a tileset.
axes.C: Catalog-aware checks join validateTilesets main; stable-ID resolution remains separate describe. Snapshot helper resolves to one provider; catalog record factory retained in existing auxiliary owner, which stays unchanged/pending.
axes.D: No-catalog positive and injected catalog positive cross different input boundaries. Wrong kind differs from missing ID; sprite neighbor exercises mixed actual catalog. Pending data-guards overlaps catalog existence, but its weaker regex/positive guard is not silently removed without full mixed-file review.
axes.E: All5 identities retained. Exact rejection messages, whole input snapshots, literal resolved AssetId and no-catalog literal records retained; no assertion removed. Old inputSnap was exact deepSnapshot forwarding helper. Negative fixtures are separately lawful catalog plus bad relation, not corrupt catalog that rejects earlier.
axes.F: One tileset.test.ts owns registration and resolution; validated and tilesets replace vague v/reg bindings. Suite name names validator, not milestone/contributor.
axes.G: Remove residual file/group and forwarding import with no new tests or public exports. Preserve catalog factory instead of copying or broadly redesigning pending fixture module.
axes.H: Deterministic unknown-input guard,real catalog validation and explicit arguments. Full typed comparison protects imports/types/last assertions; content and editor neighbors pass without diagnostics. No scene-render visual acceptance or full source acceptance inferred.

reads.scope: Only selected two cohort subjects get F/G acceptance; real callers have explicit read ranges, not whole-file acceptance. project-map fully read as dependency.

reusedEvidence.scope: Prior A-E/H with original cohort hashes; current full reads and exact bounded typed changes supplement F/G. No previous counters rerun or invented.

knownAdjacentObservations: data-guards.glm-o.test.ts stamp/tileset groups overlap standard refusal contracts; whole mixed file remains pending outside fixed178. Only lines1-117 read here, no removal/acceptance.
Existing cursor-pure fixtures retain remaining real consumers and are byte-preserved. This slice narrows imports only, not auxiliary ownership or API.
processDisclosures: Registration sourceBridges recreate lexical contexts only; independent full typed proof limits actual delta.
JSON-only stamp snapshot forwarding replaced only for fully literal JSON fixture; no equivalence promise for undefined/Date/Map or typed arrays.
Integration wording correction: stamp E says expected values, not transformed bytes; this is a content-value test, not a binary codec. Initial producer retained.
invalidations: Typed test/helper/import changes or canonical map/anchor/collision/catalog rules and caller contracts require targeted revalidation. Package-green does not validate per-file quality.
